title: Personal Loans AutoPay Discount Step for an AutoPay Debit Record
content:
## Rule

A debit-record AutoPay discount step applies to a Personal Loans AutoPay enrollment, counting the AutoPay debits posted on the loan fewer than 24 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the enrollment date less the AutoPay debits returned in those months: 20 or more add 0.1 point; 12 to 19 add 0.05 point; fewer than 12 add no step. An AutoPay debit is any payment AutoPay took on the loan, a hardship plan payment included, and an AutoPay debit returned is a return of such a payment.

A step is added to the AutoPay discount by which the loan's base interest rate is reduced from the enrollment date; the rate is rounded to two decimals once, at the end.

| AutoPay debits posted less returned, fewer than 24 whole months back | Step |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 0.10 point |
| 12 to 19 | 0.05 point |
| fewer than 12 | none |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A loan re-enrolling after a cancellation, with 21 AutoPay debits posted in the time and 1 returned: 20: 0.10 point.
- 14 posted and 3 returned: 11: none.
